2609.27385.title: Forecast Workflow Bench: Evaluating Language-Model Decisions with Budgeted Forecast Tools
2609.27385.paper_summary: Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide forecasts for operational decisions, but accuracy alone does not determine their value. Evaluating agents that use these models requires measuring decision quality and forecast cost. FWBench evaluates this capability on 1,251 electricity and cycle-hire cases using fixed forecast tools and simulated capacity contracts. Agents select models, histories and horizons, then submit capacities to minimize a stated loss-cost objective. We evaluated two hosted and eight local configurations, including small language models, and tested local models with and without TSFMs. GPT-6 Astra bought inexpensive short-horizon forecasts selectively, using 2.5% of the budget, and outperformed fixed policies when the saved decisions were scored with three loss-cost weightings. FWBench enables reproducible evaluation of how language models select and use time-series forecasts to make decisions under cost constraints.
2609.27385.paper_summary_zh: 時間序列基礎模型（TSFMs）為操作決策提供預測，但僅僅準確性並不能決定它們的價值。評估使用這些模型的代理需要測量決策質量和預測成本。FWBench 在 1,251 個電力和自行車租賃案例中評估了這一能力，使用固定預測工具和模擬的容量合約。代理選擇模型、歷史和預測範圍，然後提交容量以最小化所述的損失成本目標。我們評估了兩個託管和八個本地配置，包括小型語言模型，並測試了有無 TSFMs 的本地模型。GPT-6 Astra 有選擇性地購買便宜的短期預測，使用了 2.5% 的預算，並在保存的決策以三種損失成本權重進行評分時超越了固定政策。FWBench 使得可重複評估語言模型如何選擇和使用時間序列預測在成本限制下做出決策成為可能。
2609.27385.author: Shunya Nagashima et.al.
